title: India has heat action plans. But where is the budget?
description: For millions of Indians, heat is experienced not through meteorological bulletins but inside a tin-roofed room that does not cool after sunset, at a work site where stopping work means losing wages, or in fields under a scorching sun. Yet extreme heat remains difficult to locate as a distinct priority in India’s public finances.
